deploybot: 🚀 Canary deploy STARTED for runtime-api in prod-usw1
- tag: v3.1.0-canary-20260320
- commit: a1b2c3d4
- traffic: 2% (mini-ramp plan 2->10->25)
- strategy: rolling pods, graceful drain on old
Logs & details: https://deploys.redwood/bot/12345

maya: oncall here, watching logs and traces — will post smoke summary shortly

alex: pushed a tiny readiness tweak (timeout 10s -> 15s) to help cold starts, new image sha a1b2c3d5

deploybot: UPDATE: canary rollout to 2% complete, 4 pods serving. readiness/health checks passing. smoke tests triggered.

jen: quick metrics: p50 ~80ms, p95 ~210ms, error rate baseline ~0.00% -> observed 0.01% transient spike. CPU ~38% on canary nodes :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: saw a tiny 5xx blip at 12:15 correlated with a burst of traffic from internal canary replays. tracking dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/runtime-api-canary

deploybot: Canary health summary: checks green apart from the 5xx spike noted by @sre-oncall. Kicking off extended probes (10m) before next step.

maya: recommend holding at 2% until extended probe finishes (+10m). will escalate if we see sustained errors.

alex: fine by me. if probe is clean we should step to 10% and run integration suite.

deploybot: PROMOTION DECISION: holding window complete, probes stable. Rolling update to 10% now. routing policy updated for tag v3.1.0-canary-20260320 -> 10%

qa-automation: integration smoke triggered against 10% population, ETA ~8m. posting failures if any.

jen: after 10% sample: latencies stable, no new errors, traffic profile looks normal. I recommend continue to 25%. :rocket:

sre-oncall: +1 to ramp. pinning fallback: stable_tag=v3.0.8 in case we need immediate rollback.

deploybot: ROLLFORWARD: ramp to 25% in progress. 25% complete. Auto-rollback trigger configured to revert to v3.0.8 on critical errors. Full deploy record: https://deploys.redwood/bot/12345

maya: thanks team — monitoring for 30m watch window then we can decide full promotion or keep canary extended.

alex: noted, I'll prepare release notes draft and changelog entry for the tag.

deploybot: FIN: canary ramp to 25% finished; status=healthy. If anyone sees anomalies react here or ping @sre-oncall.
